Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds and knocked back [[1d5]] metres. Challenging (+0) Agility Test or knocked Prone.
Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and all movement halved for [[1d10]] hours.
The target dies. Anyone within 4 metres must pass an Agility Test or take -10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill on their next turn.

As result 9. In addition the attack carries through: with a melee weapon the attacker may immediately attack any other target he can reach without moving; with a ranged weapon, any target directly behind the original and still in range.
